player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Wild Tic Tac Toe.
On your turn, you can place either an 'X' or an 'O' in an empty square.
You win by aligning three of the same mark (X or O) in a row.
You can win with either symbol.
Choose your move using the format '[X 4]' to place X in the center.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid move format. Use '[X 4]' or '[O 2]' format.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Nambala ya chizuvo yize kuyishi ni ulemu: {cell}. Yatela kupwa hakachi ka 0 hanga 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Invalid move. Cell {cell} is already occupied.

game_action.placed: Mchezaji {player_id} alitumia ishara yake ({mark}) kwenye seli {cell}

outcome.win: Mutu yoze {player_id} akuwina ni yuma ya {mark}!
